title: RPO looks backward; RTO looks forward
description: An illustrative recovery timeline. Recovery point objective bounds the acceptable data-loss window before an outage; recovery time objective bounds the time to restore service after the outage. Five and thirty minutes are independent examples, not WAF defaults.

nodes.label:
RPO / data-loss window
Example: at most 5 minutes

RTO / time to restore
Example: at most 30 minutes
